headline: Coast Guard renames 5 ships, dropping national leaders' names
summary: The BCGS Joy Bangla and four vessels named after national leaders have been renamed by order of the home ministry.
details: The Bangladesh Coast Guard has renamed five of its vessels, including the ship BCGS Joy Bangla and four others named after national leaders.
The home ministry issued an order on Thursday stating that the changes were made with the approval of the 'appropriate authority'.
The move comes as part of a broader effort to rename various national assets and institutions.
The specific new names for the ships have not been disclosed in the immediate order.

headline: 1,276 dead as measles outbreak kills four more in 24 hours
summary: The DGHS reports a surge in measles and measles-like symptoms, with Dhaka Division recording the highest number of fatalities.
details: Four people with measles symptoms died in the past 24 hours, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS). All four deaths occurred in the Dhaka Division.
This brings the total death toll from measles and measles-like symptoms to 1,276 since March 15. Of these, 105 deaths were confirmed cases of measles, while 1,171 showed symptoms.

Dhaka Division has been the hardest hit, recording 526 deaths. Sylhet follows with 204, Chattogram with 114, and other divisions including Rajshahi, Mymensingh, Barishal, Khulna, and Rangpur also reported fatalities.
In the last 24 hours alone, 1,239 people across the country developed symptoms, and 75 tested positive for the disease. 1,128 patients were admitted to hospitals nationwide.
Since March 15, a total of 236,714 people have developed measles symptoms, and 24,294 cases have been confirmed. 210,982 patients were admitted to hospitals, with 202,394 recovering.
The DGHS noted that the actual number of infections may be higher as not all patients visiting hospitals or those staying at home do not undergo testing.
